forbidden: The capability uses runtime credentials without naming any denied output location.
oracle.observable: Static inspection of the capability declaration and validation result shows an explicit denied-output location.

acceptance.then: The capability declaration contains a resolvable denied-output location.
acceptance.when: The capability package is validated under the SM-A15 capability checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the capability validation case with a runtime-credential declaration whose denied-output location is omitted; select the missing denied-output assertion.

acceptance.given: Static validation receives a version-sensitive Skill declaration containing one or more SM-A14 defects.

acceptance.then: The defective declaration is rejected with bounded, rule-scoped diagnostics and no lookup side effect.
acceptance.when: The capability validation test invokes the static validator against each defect fixture.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject every listed SM-A14 defect with bounded diagnostics while avoiding network lookups and raw-content disclosure.
